card.name: Small words in C# class and struct text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (the, from, with, can, of, a comma) inside programming text about .NET classes, structs, constructors and Object methods like Equals and GetHashCode. A few hits fall on stray words in dosing text.
